The mainstream script pushes the lie that a simple court ruling happened in Indiana earlier this month, where Judge Christina R. stepped in to block a prolife law. Do not fall for the surface-level deception. This isn't about genuine constitutional rights or religious freedom at all. It is a calculated, top-down maneuver by the hidden elites and institutional architects orchestrating this entire agenda. When the system uses its own judges to protect and enshrine these practices under the guise of "freedom," you are witnessing the inversion of truth in real-time. They dress it up as piety and rights, but it’s just another coordinated push by the puppet masters to dismantle traditional foundations and normalize their hidden mandates from the top down.
